event_text: Journal Technologies says it identified suspicious automated activity targeting its public portal technology and advised customers to suspend portal access
notes: No time of day given. Riverside's court says it was advised that Friday.

event_text: The FBI publishes an advisory on the ARTEX hacking framework; it does not mention this vendor
notes: Date only.

event_text: King County District Court (Washington) says the vendor alerted users to a critical vulnerability and urged them to take portals offline; the court shut its portal
notes: Time as stated in the court's Nov 20 order; the order is from a Washington court, so read as local (Pacific) time.

event_text: Journal Technologies publishes its first public statement; Los Angeles Superior Court says its reservation system and the vendor's e-filing site are offline
notes: The court's announcement was “late Monday”; the vendor's page is dated Nov 16.

event_text: Riverside court's internal network comes back; its public portal stays down
notes: Per a court spokesperson quoted by MyNewsLA.

event_text: Alameda court posts that its eCourt portal and the vendor's e-filing service remain offline; FOX40 reports outages at Sacramento, Alameda, Kern, Las Vegas and Spokane courts
notes: FOX40 first posted at 1:56 PM Pacific and updated at 6:04 PM Pacific.

event_text: Illinois's 19th Judicial Circuit (Lake County) says its eCourt portal is offline over security concerns identified by Journal Technologies
notes: Date of release only.

event_text: The Sacramento Bee reports portals offline at 20 California superior courts, by its own count
notes: Time as stated on the article.

event_text: Local outlets report Ventura County's and Spokane's court portals still down
notes: Ventura County Star 1:07 PM Pacific.

event_text: Journal Technologies says it released a secured build supporting the portal version used by about 90% of affected customers
notes: No time of day given.

event_text: Lake County's circuit clerk in Illinois says it is still working with its vendor to restore the eCourt public portal
notes: Date only, as posted.

event_text: King County's Superior Court Clerk says its portal will stay unavailable through Nov 29; the county's District Court issues an emergency order on its outage
notes: Date only.

event_text: Our check: Kern's court page still says its portal is offline with no ETA; Marin's and Washoe's courts also still show their portals down
notes: Own first-hand read.

event_text: Riverside's court restores its eCourt public access portal, a day after the vendor released its secured build
notes: Date from IE Law News; the court's own notice is undated. No time of day given.

event_text: Law.com reports online records at 19 California trial courts still blocked as the outage enters a second week
notes: Time is approximate (the outlet says Monday morning, Pacific time not given). KCLU reported Ventura still affected the same day.

event_text: Our check: Riverside's court page says its eCourt public access portal is restored and that users must reset their passwords; Kern's court still shows no ETA
notes: Own first-hand read. The Riverside notice itself is undated.

event_text: Our check: Ventura's court home page still says its civil, probate and small claims portal and eDelivery are unavailable; Kern's court still says offline with no ETA
notes: Own first-hand read. The Pacific Coast Business Times reported Ventura still down on Nov 22.

event_text: The Seattle Times reports King County Superior Court's portal will stay down about another week, with Nov 29 an estimate; the court says its portal was not hacked
notes: The time is the article's publication time.

event_text: Ventura County's court issues a press release: about 20 California superior courts are affected; its civil, probate and small claims portal and the JTI e-filing service are still down, with no restoration date
notes: The release gives a date but no time.

event_text: King County District Court publishes a letter saying it is testing the vendor's new portal software and will not restore its portal until its own testing confirms it is secure
notes: The letter, published by Westside Seattle, gives a date but no time.

event_text: Kern County's court posts that its eCourt public portal is live again and that users must reset their passwords
notes: The alert gives a date but no time.

event_text: Alameda County's court posts that its eCourt public portal is operational again, saying the vendor has resolved the security issues
notes: The notice gives a date but no time.
